description: Known corpus failures that need a product decision or a larger fix. Each entry turns the named check into a strict xfail for that item: the run stays green while the issue exists and fails as soon as it is fixed, so the entry gets removed. 'check' is an invariant test name (e.g. test_photo_total_matches_listing) or a spot-fact id.
